register_actions: register read_store and write_store actions in an ActionEngine ActionRegistry for Redis chunk store operations
read_store_chunks_into_queue: read chunks from a Redis ChunkStore into an asyncio queue with configurable offset, count, and timeout
write_store_run: write binary data as a chunk to a Redis ChunkStore with a specified key and offset
read_store_http_handler: read chunks from a Redis ChunkStore via HTTP with optional SSE streaming support and configurable timeout
register_http_routes: register FastAPI HTTP routes under /streams prefix for reading chunks from a Redis ChunkStore
